title: How treatment access changes in the model
question: How do telehealth and treatment access change?

scenes.title: Telehealth enters the access pathway
scenes.narration: The 2026 snapshot adds a modeled link from Telehealth Treatment to Treatment Access, a connection not included in the 2010 snapshot. This introduces remote treatment into the graph's represented access pathway.

fact.title: A new connection: Telehealth Treatment
fact.claim: The later snapshot includes Telehealth Treatment → Treatment Access (sign +, modeled strength 0.70); this edge is absent from the earlier snapshot. Absence does not establish that the relationship did not exist in reality.
